# Portfolio Bus Route Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Bring the landing page at `/` up to `templates/portfolio/Portfolio.dc.html` — the hero gains ambient motion, and Experience becomes a bus route down one road.

**Architecture:** The page is generated by `tools/build-site.mjs` into `site/index.html`; styles live in `tools/template/site.css` and are copied to `/assets/site.css`. The Experience section's data array, SVG geometry and card markup are emitted from `build-site.mjs`; all styling is class-based in `site.css`; per-card placement travels as a `--top` custom property on the element. One new client script, `tools/template/portfolio.js`, drives the bus.

**Tech Stack:** Node ESM (no framework), hand-written CSS, inline SVG. No new dependencies.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-08-portfolio-bus-route-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- **Never edit `site/`** — it is build output. Change `tools/**` and rebuild.
- Geometry and copy come from the design file **verbatim**: path `d` strings, polygon points, stop percentages, animation durations and delays, and all prose.
- The five CI gates must pass before any task is called done:
  ```bash
  node tools/check-dsa.mjs
  python3 tools/check-python.py
  cd tools && node render-diagrams.mjs && node build-site.mjs && cd ..
  node tools/check-site.mjs
  ```
- `git status --porcelain` must be empty when a task is finished. Untracked files have been lost to `git clean` in this repo before.
- Colours come from the tokens already in `site.css:8-30` (`--ink`, `--acc`, `--paper`, `--ink-2`, `--prose`, `--mut`, `--cut`, `--lift`) except where the design deliberately hardcodes a scene colour — mountain greys, pine greens, the bus body and the sun stay literal hexes, matching how the existing `landscape` SVG already writes its fills.
- Notes card keeps `/vault/` and `cartmancodes.com/vault →`; notes counts stay build-derived. Do not "fix" these toward the design file — see the deviation table in the spec.

```css
/* experience — the career as a bus route down one road. The wrapper holds the
   SVG's aspect ratio so the stop cards can be placed in percentages and stay
   pinned to their kerb at any width. */
.pf-exp { position: relative; }
.pf-exp-label {
  position: absolute; left: var(--pf-pad); top: 20px; z-index: 2; margin-top: 0;
}
.pf-road { position: relative; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 960px; aspect-ratio: 1000 / 1600; }
.pf-roadsvg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }

/* the road, drawn twice: fat translucent asphalt, thin dashed centreline */
.pf-asphalt { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 26; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .12; }
.pf-lane { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 14 12; }
.pf-mark { fill: var(--acc); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 3; }
.pf-terminus { fill: var(--ink); }
.pf-terminus-in { fill: var(--acc); }

.pf-stop {
  position: absolute; width: min(400px, 39%);
  background: var(--paper); border: var(--cut); border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: var(--lift); padding: 14px 16px;
}
.pf-stop-l { left: 59%; top: var(--top); }
.pf-stop-r { right: 59%; top: var(--top); }
/* the terminus card is the current job: centred on the road, wider, and filled
   accent instead of white, so the route reads as arriving somewhere */
.pf-stop-end {
  left: 50%; bottom: -12px; transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: min(540px, 64%); background: var(--acc);
}
.pf-stop-when {
  display: inline-block; padding: 3px 9px; border: var(--cut); border-radius: 100px;
  font: 700 10.5px var(--mono); background: var(--acc);
}
/* on the accent card the pills invert so they stay legible against the fill */
.pf-stop-end .pf-stop-when, .pf-stop-end .pf-founding { background: var(--paper); }
.pf-stop h3 { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.pf-stop p { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.pf-stop-end p { color: var(--prose); }
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create the script**

Create `tools/template/portfolio.js`:

```js
// The bus drives the career road. Its distance along the lane tracks how far the
// reader has scrolled the road through the viewport, and it banks into the
// curves by sampling a second point just ahead for the tangent.
//
// This is scroll-linked motion, which is what prefers-reduced-motion exists to
// suppress — under that setting the listeners are never attached and the bus is
// parked at the terminus instead. The road, the stops and the dashes all still
// render, so nothing is lost but the movement.
(() => {
  const wrap = document.querySelector('.pf-road');
  const lane = document.getElementById('pf-lane');
  const bus = document.getElementById('pf-bus');
  if (!wrap || !lane || !bus) return;

  const len = lane.getTotalLength();
  if (!len) return;

  function park(dist) {
    const at = lane.getPointAtLength(dist);
    const ahead = lane.getPointAtLength(Math.min(len, dist + 2));
    const angle = Math.atan2(ahead.y - at.y, ahead.x - at.x) * 180 / Math.PI;
    bus.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${at.x},${at.y}) rotate(${angle - 90})`);
  }

  if (matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) { park(len); return; }

  function drive() {
    const box = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    // 0 while the road's top edge is still below 72% of the viewport height, 1
    // once the terminus has come up to meet it
    const p = (innerHeight * 0.72 - box.top) / Math.max(1, box.height - 140);
    park(Math.max(1, Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p)) * len));
  }

  addEventListener('scroll', drive, { passive: true });
  addEventListener('resize', drive);
  drive();
  // web fonts and the polaroid can reflow the page after first paint
  setTimeout(drive, 400);
})();
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Add the ambience CSS**

In `tools/template/site.css`, insert this immediately after the `.pf-hero-shell` rule (line 906):

```css
/* hero ambience — the scene is alive: the sun turning, clouds crossing, pines
   swaying, the polaroid hanging off its top corner. All of it stops under the
   global prefers-reduced-motion rule near the top of this file. */
@keyframes pf-sunspin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes pf-drift { from { transform: translateX(-180px); } to { transform: translateX(112vw); } }
@keyframes pf-bob { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-4px); } }
@keyframes pf-sway { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-2.6deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(-1.1deg); } }

.pf-sun {
  position: absolute; top: 78px; right: 44px; width: 86px; height: 86px; z-index: 1;
  transform-origin: center; animation: pf-sunspin 40s linear infinite;
}

/* a cloud is a pill plus a half-disc puff; the puff drops its bottom border and
   paints over the pill's top edge, so the two shapes read as one silhouette.
   .pf-hero already clips, so they simply leave at the right edge. */
.pf-cloud {
  position: absolute; left: 0; z-index: 1;
  background: var(--paper); border: var(--cut); border-radius: 100px;
  animation: pf-drift linear infinite;
}
.pf-cloud::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute;
  background: var(--paper); border: var(--cut); border-bottom: none; border-radius: 50%;
}
/* negative delays so the sky is already mid-crossing on first paint */
.pf-cloud-a { top: 36px; width: 92px; height: 26px; animation-duration: 46s; }
.pf-cloud-a::before { left: 22px; top: -15px; width: 44px; height: 32px; }
.pf-cloud-b { top: 96px; width: 64px; height: 18px; animation-duration: 60s; animation-delay: -32s; }
.pf-cloud-b::before { left: 15px; top: -11px; width: 32px; height: 24px; }
.pf-cloud-c { top: 64px; width: 80px; height: 22px; animation-duration: 52s; animation-delay: -14s; }
.pf-cloud-c::before { left: 19px; top: -13px; width: 38px; height: 28px; }

/* the road leaves the right mountain and runs off the bottom edge, where the
   experience road picks it up */
.pf-hero-asphalt { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 22; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .12; }
.pf-hero-lane { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 12 10; }

.pf-pines { animation: pf-bob 3.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pf-pines-b { animation-duration: 4.2s; animation-delay: -1.6s; }
```

## Notes for the implementer

- Line numbers in the **Files** blocks are as of commit `296896f` and shift as you edit. Anchor on the symbol names, not the numbers.
- `esc()` is the build's HTML escaper, defined near the top of `build-site.mjs`. Every string that comes from data goes through it; the SVG geometry and the class names do not.
- If a gate fails on something in `LLD/**` or `DSA/**`, it is not from this work — those files are untouched here.
